title: Please add keyboard shortcuts to the Desktop App to move between Chat, Cowork, Code and Conversations
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

I want shortcuts or at least in the menu so I can assign MacOS keyboard shortcuts to Claude desktop so that it makes it easier to navigate the application. Right now you have to go and click on the on if you want to be in chat or call work or code and then you have to go and click on the different conversations. I mean I get it in the conversations you probably could do a command one, command two, command three or if you put it in a go option in the menu again I can create Mac OS keyboard shortcuts but navigating the app right now is a bit of a pain because of the fact that you can't have to go with the mouse every single time 

### Proposed Solution

Either add the shortcuts or add them to the menus in the application. That way we can assign Mac OS keyboard shortcuts 

### Alternative Solutions

_No response_

### Priority

Medium - Would be very helpful

### Feature Category

CLI commands and flags

_No response_

author: ernesto-luis

top_comments.author: sackville
top_comments.body:
I was wondering this same thing, and thought it would be nice to use control-tab, which is the key command for switching between tabs in browsers (and other tab-driven interfaces).

The use case I'm targeting is when I get a response from Claude that makes me think "I should capture that idea for a later discussion," and I want to switch quickly to Cowork to add a reminder. My fingers would love to stay on the keyboard as I complete that interaction and switch back to Chat.

top_comments.author: shoshiro
top_comments.body: plus one on this. i switched from claude code to claude desktop and the lack of keyboard shortcuts is annoying.

top_comments.author: theoctano
top_comments.body: I agree, started using more Desktop App since Cowork is not available in CLI and have been surely bothered by the near-to-zero customization.
